ss_lcd16x2.name: ss_lcd16x2
ss_lcd16x2.description: 32 text cells as four 64-bit buses. Cell 0=text_0 bits 7:0. Initializes even with en=0; en only gates new frames, never interrupts E. update while busy ignored. RW=0.
ss_lcd16x2.inputNotes: 32 text cells as four 64-bit buses. Cell 0=text_0 bits 7:0. Initializes even with en=0; en only gates new frames, never interrupts E. update while busy ignored. RW=0.

ss_lcd_write.name: ss_lcd_write
ss_lcd_write.description: 8-bit LCD byte transaction. start while busy ignored. Data/RS held; RW=0. Timing is in main-clock cycles.
ss_lcd_write.inputNotes: 8-bit LCD byte transaction. start while busy ignored. Data/RS held; RW=0. Timing is in main-clock cycles.
